top_choice_rationale: Targeted protein degradation is a new molecule-design problem (target ligand, ligase ligand, linker, ternary-complex cooperativity) whose principle is reproduced across many laboratories and ligases; Crews, Deshaies and Ciulli form a coherent three-name credit if the citation stays on heterobifunctional degraders and leaves the cereblon glue strand to the background. Nitrogenase structure is the more secure but more structural-biology result, and base editing is a strong method but sits close to the 2020 CRISPR prize apart from the evolved-deaminase chemistry.
